programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep01

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep03

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep04
programme.desc: Having unleashed her elf magic on the Holy Knights, Nephy confides in Zagan, who then takes Nephy as his apprentice in sorcery. Half a month later, Zagan is summoned by the Archdemons.

programme.desc: Makoto and his classmates are transported to another world, but he is the only weak one. Pairing up with a forgotten goddess, Noah, Makoto aims for the top using unorthodox methods, hardcore mode!
